title: Matrix Interpolation
text: Interpolate between matrices, 4 inputs, 1 output, {Interpolation method} sets Interpolation method; {Extrapolation method}, {Interpolate Dimension} sets the number of lookup table dimensions, {Table data} sets the table of output and {Simulate using} sets the simulation mode Code generation. Values come from the instance.
